test_dataframe_plot_line: test the dataframe plot.line method to create a line chart from polars dataframe columns
test_dataframe_plot_scatter: test the dataframe plot.scatter method to create a scatter chart with color encoding
test_dataframe_plot_bar: test the dataframe plot.bar method to create a bar chart with x, y, and color parameters
test_dataframe_plot_tooltip: test the dataframe plot tooltip with default boolean and custom field encoding

test_errorbar_plot: test the dataframe and series plot.errorbar method with yError parameter
